company.name: JetonAI
company.shortDescription: Jeton.AI Edge AI Computing for Web3 Large AI Model Acceleration Platform on Edge Device for Web3 World
company.description: Jeton.AI is a cutting-edge Edge AI platform for the Web3 era, enabling efficient deployment of large AI models (LLMs) on mobile devices. With model compression, fine-tuning, and multimodal capabilities, it supports text and image generation without GPUs, lowering AI costs. Its open SDK and edge computing framework empower developers to build AI dApps easily. Users earn cryptocurrency through data sharing, while developers leverage an innovative token economy. Jeton.AI bridges Web3 and AI, driving a decentralized future.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for running and accelerating large AI models on mobile and edge devices, supporting Web3 integration and multimodal AI tasks.
productsAndServices.name: Jeton.AI Edge AI Computing Platform

productsAndServices.description: Services for fine-tuning, domain tuning, and compressing large language models to optimize them for specific AI needs on mobile devices.
productsAndServices.name: Jeton.AI Model Compression and Fine-tuning Services

productsAndServices.description: An open software development kit and open-source edge computing framework for building embedded AI applications and decentralized AI DApps.
productsAndServices.name: Jeton.AI Open SDK and Edge Computing Framework

productsAndServices.description: A unified platform supporting text-to-text AI, intelligent chatbots, reasoning agents, and text-to-image AI with multimodal integration and no GPU requirement.
productsAndServices.name: Jeton.AI Unified Platform for Text and Visual AI

productsAndServices.description: Services providing edge AI nodes, model pruning, and hybrid acceleration combining edge and cloud AI to reduce infrastructure costs for AI DApps.
productsAndServices.name: Jeton.AI Edge AI Node and Hybrid Edge Services
